title: US equity, options and bond markets closed — Thanksgiving Day (the 2026 full closure this calendar tracks the half-day for but not the holiday)
source: NEWS: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200 after its 302, 109,180 bytes) and parsed cell by cell by the christmas-market-closure-2026-12-25 initial research. The Thanksgiving Day row parses as ['Thursday, November 26***', 'Thursday, November 25***', 'Thursday, November 23***'] for 2026 / 2027 / 2028, so 2026 is a full closure on Thursday November 26; footnote *** reads verbatim 'Each market will close early at 1:00 p.m. (1:15 p.m. for eligible options) on Friday, November 27, 2026, Friday, November 26, 2027, and Friday, November 24, 2028 (the day after Thanksgiving)', which is the entry this calendar already carries as thanksgiving-half-day-2026-11-27. CORROBORATED FROM TWO FURTHER PRIMARIES IN THE SAME SESSION: the OCC's own expiration calendar (www.optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar, HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes) marks 2026-11-26 {"holiday":{"description":"Exchange/OCC holiday","hatched":true}}, and SIFMA's US Holiday Recommendations 2026 panel (sifma.org/resources/guides-playbooks/holiday-schedule, HTTP 200, 299,272 bytes) gives 'Thanksgiving Day | Thursday, November 26, 2026' a full fixed-income close with 'Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Friday, November 27, 2026'. Reproduced by statute and weekday arithmetic: 5 U.S.C. 6103 fixes Thanksgiving on the FOURTH Thursday of November, and November 2026's Thursdays are the 5th, 12th, 19th and 26th. Filed estimate on the two counts every sibling closure entry documents — the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for an exchange's or a trade association's own holiday calendar, and a discovering lane may not self-confirm an event it found in-sweep. The DATE is not in doubt; the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: PROPOSED by the christmas-market-closure-2026-12-25 initial research (2026-09-08). THIS IS AN EXPLICIT HAND-OFF, NOT A FRESH DISCOVERY: the proposal that seeded this proposer's own id (proposals/christmas-market-closure-2026-12-25.from-sp-select-sector-secondary-reweight-2026-12-31.json) named thanksgiving-market-closure-2026-11-26 as the same patterned omission, declined to file it as scope creep from its own corridor, and recorded it 'as an observation for whichever lane's sweep next reaches it'. This lane reached it: researching one 2026 full closure means holding the NYSE holiday table open, and the Thanksgiving row is four cells above the Christmas row on the same fetch. The pattern the two entries share is that this calendar tracks BOTH 2026 equity half-days (thanksgiving-half-day-2026-11-27, christmas-eve-half-day-2026-12-24) while carrying NEITHER of the full closures they hang off, which is backwards: a half day is a footnote to a closure, not the other way round. WHY IT IS WORTH A ROW RATHER THAN A NOTE: the proposer measured the same release-compression shape at both 2026 closures. Wednesday 2026-11-25, the last full session before this closure, carries FIVE confirmed US macro prints in this calendar (beige-book, durable-goods, gdp-q3-2026-second, new-home-sales, pce) — more than any other date in the calendar except 2026-09-16 — and Wednesday 2026-12-23 carries four ahead of the Christmas closure. Two closures, two stacked last-full-sessions; a lane reading either corridor without the closure on the calendar sees the stack and not its cause. Low impact: a scheduled closure known 79 days ahead moves no price and licenses nothing. Kind sector, symbols empty and status estimate reuse the settled precedent every US trading-hours entry in this calendar follows. NOT PROPOSED alongside it, and named here so the next sweep does not re-derive it: SIFMA also recommends a 2:00 p.m. ET US fixed-income early close on Friday 2026-11-27 against NYSE's 1:00 p.m. equity close — the same bonds-outlive-equities inversion the Christmas Eve entry records — which would be a sifma-bond-early-close-2026-11-27 row. It is left unfiled because it is two steps outside this proposer's corridor, not because it is doubtful.
